# Mali Franzese

> Founder-Engineer at The MASS Lab, an independent software practice based in Texas.
> Builds and ships production multi-tenant SaaS platforms end to end, with AI-assisted
> development as a core method. Currently pursuing a B.S. in Cybersecurity at Western
> Governors University.

Also known as: Anomali007 (handle, GitHub and personal site).
Not affiliated with Anomali Incorporated, the cybersecurity company.
Not related to Michael Franzese or Sonny Franzese.

## Practice and products

- [The MASS Lab](https://themasslab.com): the engineering practice. Legal entity MASS LLC.
- [MASS Lab Connect](https://masslabconnect.com): managed AI that answers, routes and books
  customer calls, with an auditable record of every interaction.
- [Token Holder](https://tokenholder.io): a data-sovereignty layer between AI agents and
  your data. Grant-gated access and signed audit trails.
- [Home Team Education](https://hometeameducation.org): youth financial-literacy curriculum
  and free resources.
